edbDesc: A situation in which a body or material (for example, tidal water, or the Moon) is mainly under the gravitational influence of a second body (for example, the Earth), but is also perturbed by the gravitational effects of a third body (for example, by the Moon in the case of tidal water, or by the Sun in the case of the Moon).
title: Tidal Force
pickWhy: The deck's tides card covers the effect (Roche limit follows from it).
